fusions.name: Correcting Stroke
fusions.desc: Strikes a target carrying one of your afflictions and uses it up, dealing 8 damage and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Recited Furrow
fusions.desc: After a 0.8 second recital, drags a cone of arcana 4 tiles ahead of you that deals 26 damage to everything in it. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Repeat Recital
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Practiced Gathering
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 3% more damage per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
